notes.title: Achievements Added!
notes.content:
Steam Achievements have been added and the other changes that have been applied in this update are listed below.

- Graffiti hinting at the locations of specific Grand Masters and Chambers can be found in various areas

- Minor adjustments to the player character's movement and platforming abilities

- Minor adjustments to enemies' AI

notes.title: Update - Version 1.3.3.4
notes.content:
Another small update. There should no longer be any issues with the player sticking to walls. I do apologize, sincerely, for any bugs anyone may have encountered. Please do let me know if there are any more.

Thanks again for all of the feedback and support. It does mean way more than I can type and helps out a whole lot. Again, sorry about the bugs anyone might have come across.
